notices.title: No work permit needed
notices.body: Citizens of the EU, of Iceland, Liechtenstein and Norway, and of Switzerland, can live and work in Germany, France, Spain and the Netherlands under free movement — the routes on this site are for other passports. Check registration rules after arrival (e.g. Anmeldung in Germany).

source.quote: As an EU national you generally don't need a work permit to work anywhere in the EU.
source.legal_basis: TFEU art. 45 (free movement of workers) — Your Europe

notices.title: Türkiye: extra rights once you are legally employed
notices.body: Your route options are the same as for any other non-EU passport — the EU–Türkiye agreement adds rights after you are working, not different entry criteria.

source.quote: As a national of Türkiye, your rights to live and work in an EU country depend entirely on the national rules of that country. When employed legally in the EU, you enjoy the same working conditions as the nationals of that country and you have the following rights: after one year's legal employment you are entitled to a renewal of your work permit for the same employer if a job is available after three years' legal employment you may change employers and respond to any other employment offer within the same professional qualifications after four years' legal employment you enjoy full access to any paid employment in that EU country.
source.legal_basis: EEC–Turkey Association Agreement, Decision 1/80 art. 6 — Your Europe

routes.name: EU Blue Card — shortage occupation
routes.summary: A lower salary threshold, for occupations on Germany's shortage list — IT, engineering, health and others.
preconditions: An employment contract of at least six months
If your profession is regulated (health, law and similar), the professional licence must already be in hand

threshold.quote: Personen mit einem Mangelberuf und Berufseinsteigende können die Blaue Karte EU auch mit einem geringeren Bruttojahresgehalt beantragen, welches 2026 45.934,20 Euro beträgt.
threshold.legal_basis: § 18g AufenthG

routes.name: EU Blue Card — general
routes.summary: The standard EU Blue Card: a recognised university degree and a salary above the general threshold, in any qualified job.
preconditions: An employment contract of at least six months
If your profession is regulated (health, law and similar), the professional licence must already be in hand

threshold.quote: Für die „große“ Blaue Karte EU muss ein Mindestbruttojahresgehalt erreicht werden, welches im Jahr 2026 50.700 Euro beträgt.
threshold.legal_basis: § 18g AufenthG

routes.name: Skilled worker — academic (§ 18b)
routes.summary: Your university degree is recognised in Germany and the job matches it. There is no salary threshold — but from age 45 an extra salary requirement applies, or proof of pension provision.
preconditions: The job matches the qualification that was recognised

criteria.note: BAMF: "Proof of a German or recognised foreign university degree or a foreign university degree which is comparable to a German university degree"

routes.name: Skilled worker — vocational (§ 18a)
routes.summary: Your vocational training is recognised in Germany and you have a job offer that matches it. There is no salary threshold — but from age 45 an extra salary requirement applies.
preconditions: Enough German for the job itself — how much depends on the work
Enough income to live on without state support, plus health insurance (the salary from the job normally covers this)

criteria.note: BAMF: "vocational qualifications acquired abroad which are equivalent to qualified German vocational training"

routes.name: Experienced worker (§ 19c / § 6 BeschV)
routes.summary: No German recognition needed: two years of recent skilled work in the last five, plus either a qualification your home country officially recognises, or experience in IT.
preconditions: The salary threshold applies unless your employer is covered by a collective wage agreement
Your qualification is officially recognised in the country where you earned it

criteria.note: ZAV: "Innerhalb der letzten fünf Jahren muss eine mindestens zweijährige, einschlägige Berufserfahrung auf dem Niveau einer Fachkraft gesammelt worden sein."
Recognised by the state where it was acquired — German recognition not required (§ 6 BeschV).
§ 6 BeschV: "In Berufen auf dem Gebiet der Informations- und Kommunikationstechnologie findet Satz 1 Nummer 3 keine Anwendung"

criteria.threshold_label: 45% of the German pension contribution ceiling

threshold.quote: mind. 45.630 Euro im Jahr 2026
threshold.legal_basis: § 6 BeschV (45% der Beitragsbemessungsgrenze)

criteria.note: Waived when the employer is collectively bound (tarifgebunden, §§ 3, 5 TVG).

routes.name: Researcher (§ 18d)
routes.summary: A research institution — from a university to a company's research department — has agreed to host you and to cover the costs. The permit runs for at least a year, and you may stay 18 months afterwards to look for work.
preconditions: A signed hosting agreement with a recognised research institution

criteria.note: BAMF: "concluded a hosting agreement or corresponding contract with a research facility to carry out a research project"

routes.name: ICT Card — intra-corporate transfer (§ 19)
routes.summary: Your company moves you to its German branch for more than 90 days, as a manager, specialist or trainee. Up to three years, or one year for trainees.
preconditions: At least six months with the company before the transfer
The transfer lasts more than 90 days, in a manager, specialist or trainee role

criteria.note: BAMF: "you have been employed by the undertaking or group of undertakings for at least six months" and "the intra-corporate transfer is to last longer than 90 days"

routes.name: Opportunity Card (Chancenkarte, § 20a)
routes.summary: A one-year card to come and look for work, with part-time work of up to 20 hours a week. If your qualification is fully recognised in Germany you get it directly; otherwise you need six points from the official table. It is shown when you have no offer, transfer or hosting agreement yet.

criteria.note: The card exists to seek work — with an offer, transfer or hosting agreement the work routes above apply directly.
Embassy: "einen ausländischen Hochschulabschluss, einen mindestens zweijährigen Berufsabschluss (jeweils im Ausbildungsstaat staatlich anerkannt)"

criteria.label: a language to start with
criteria.short_reason: German at A1 (beginner) or better, or English at B2 (upper intermediate) or better
criteria.note: § 20a: German A1 ("mindestens einfache deutsche Sprachkenntnisse") OR English B2.

threshold.quote: Für den Aufenthalt in Deutschland müssen Ihnen monatlich mindestens 1.091 Euro zur Verfügung stehen.
threshold.legal_basis: § 20a AufenthG (Lebensunterhalt)

criteria.note: Embassy: "Drittstaatsangehörige, die eine volle Gleichwertigkeit der ausländischen Qualifikation nachweisen … können die Chancenkarte … ohne weitere besondere Voraussetzungen erhalten."

routes.name: Talent — qualified employee (salarié qualifié)
routes.summary: For people who earned a master's-level degree in France and have a contract of more than three months. The card lasts as long as the contract, up to four years, and the job does not have to be advertised first.
preconditions: An employment contract of more than three months

criteria.note: Fiche F16922: "Avoir un contrat de travail de plus de 3 mois"

Fiche F16922: "Avoir obtenu en France un diplôme au moins équivalent au master ou un diplôme de niveau 1 labellisé par la Conférence des grandes écoles" — this subtype is the young-graduate track; foreign-degree holders route via the Blue Card.

threshold.quote: Avoir un contrat de travail de plus de 3 mois qui prévoit une rémunération brute annuelle supérieure ou égale à 39 582 €.
threshold.legal_basis: CESEDA — carte de séjour « talent » (fiche F16922)

routes.name: EU Blue Card (talent — carte bleue européenne)
routes.summary: A contract of at least six months, plus a higher-education diploma of three years or more — or five years of comparable experience. Up to four years, and the job does not have to be advertised first.
preconditions: An employment contract of at least six months

criteria.note: Fiche F16922: "Avoir un contrat de travail de 6 mois minimum"

criteria.label: diploma or experience
criteria.note: Fiche F16922: "Avoir un diplôme sanctionnant au moins 3 années d'études supérieures ou 5 années d'expérience professionnelle de niveau comparable" (reduced to 3-in-last-7 years for listed professions — order not yet modeled).

threshold.quote: Avoir une rémunération annuelle brute supérieure ou égale à 1,5 fois le salaire brut moyen annuel de référence, soit 59 373,00 € brut annuel.
threshold.legal_basis: CESEDA — carte « talent — carte bleue européenne » (fiche F16922)

routes.name: ICT — seconded employee (salarié détaché ICT)
routes.summary: Your group moves you to France for an assignment of more than a year, in a senior or expert role. Up to three years, and it cannot be renewed.
preconditions: At least six months with the group already
The assignment lasts more than a year, in a senior or expert role

criteria.note: Fiche F33952: "Vous avez une ancienneté d'au moins 6 mois dans le groupe qui vous emploie" — "pour effectuer une mission de plus d'1 an" — "pour occuper un poste d'encadrement supérieur ou apporter une expertise"

criteria.threshold_label: resources, at the French minimum wage level
criteria.note: The fiche frames this as a resources proof (« justificatif de ressources »), not a salary threshold; SMIC-indexed, will move on SMIC revaluation.

threshold.quote: Justificatif de ressources supérieures ou égales à 1 867,02 € brut par mois
threshold.legal_basis: CESEDA — carte « salarié détaché ICT » (fiche F33952)

routes.name: Talent — employee of an innovative company
routes.summary: For a job at a company France officially recognises as innovative, in work tied to its research and development. The salary threshold is the same as the qualified-employee card, and no French degree is needed.
preconditions: Your work is directly tied to the company's research and development project
France's ministry of the economy recognises the employer as innovative

criteria.note: Fiche F16922: "Avoir des fonctions en lien direct avec le projet de recherche et de développement de cette entreprise"
Fiche F16922: "Être recruté dans une jeune entreprise innovante ou une entreprise reconnue innovante par le ministère de l'économie"
criteria.short_reason: an employer France recognises as innovative

threshold.quote: Avoir un contrat de travail qui prévoit une rémunération brute annuelle supérieure ou égale à 39 582 €.
threshold.legal_basis: CESEDA — carte « talent-salarié qualifié », parcours entreprise innovante (fiche F16922)

routes.name: Talent — employee on assignment (salarié en mission)
routes.summary: For an intra-group move to France where the French company issues your contract. Unlike the ICT card, the contract is French and the salary rule is the talent threshold.
preconditions: At least three months with the group already
The move is between branches of the same company or group

criteria.note: Fiche F16922: "Être salarié d'une entreprise établie à l'étranger et venir en France pour exercer une activité salariée dans le cadre d'une mobilité entre établissements d'une même entreprise ou entre entreprises d'un même groupe (mobilité intragroupe)" — "Avoir une ancienneté d'au moins 3 mois dans le groupe qui vous emploie"
Fiche F16922: "Avoir un contrat de travail avec l'entreprise qui vous emploie en France"
criteria.short_reason: a contract with the French entity

threshold.quote: Percevoir une rémunération brute annuelle supérieure ou égale à 39 582 €.
threshold.legal_basis: CESEDA — carte « talent-salarié qualifié », parcours salarié en mission (fiche F16922)

routes.name: EU Blue Card (tarjeta azul-UE)
routes.summary: A contract or firm offer of at least six months, plus a higher-education qualification of three years or more — or five years of comparable experience. Spain's large-companies unit decides in 20 working days, and if it does not answer in time the application counts as approved. A lower salary applies if you earned your qualification in the last three years.
preconditions: A contract or firm offer of at least six months
The application goes through Spain's large-companies unit (UGE), not a provincial office
The lower salary also applies to shortage occupations on Spain's official list — we do not check that list

criteria.note: Ley 14/2013 art. 71 bis.1.b): "un contrato de trabajo válido o una oferta firme de empleo de alta cualificación para un período de al menos seis meses"

criteria.label: qualification or experience
criteria.note: Ley 14/2013 art. 71.2.a): "una cualificación derivada de una formación de enseñanza superior de duración mínima de tres años... o acrediten un mínimo de cinco años de conocimientos, capacidades y competencias avalados por una experiencia profesional que pueda considerarse equiparable" (ICT professionals: 3-in-last-7 years — not separately modeled).

criteria.label: the salary this route asks for

criteria.threshold_label: standard amount (1.4× the Spanish average wage)
criteria.note: Threshold PDF value — flagged for human re-verification per project policy. Derivation (UGE PDF, human-read 2026-09-04): "El Instituto Nacional de Estadística (INE) publicó el pasado 28 de mayo de 2026 el dato actualizado del sueldo medio correspondiente a 2024, fijándolo en 29.540,26 €" — the threshold moves whenever the INE publishes a new average (Orden PJC/44/2026, art. 3.2: one month after publication).

threshold.quote: Nuevos umbrales salariales Tarjeta Azul. – Umbral general: 41.356,36 €
threshold.legal_basis: Ley 14/2013 art. 71 bis + Orden PJC/44/2026 (1,4× ganancia media INE)

paths.label: the lower salary for a recent qualification

criteria.short_reason: a qualification from the last 3 years
criteria.note: Whether this limb carries an institution restriction is UNVERIFIED: the Orden is the PDF tier and its text could not be read here (2026-09-07). The limb we model reads "a qualification obtained within the last 3 years" and states no institution scope. The Dutch equivalent does carry one, but applying that by analogy would be a guess in the other direction. Recorded in data/exclusions.md; needs a human read of the Orden.

criteria.threshold_label: lower amount for a qualification from the last 3 years
criteria.note: Threshold PDF value — flagged for human re-verification per project policy. The Orden gives two limbs; only the qualification-within-3-years limb is modelled (see the route's preconditions).

threshold.quote: – Umbral reducido: 33.085,09 €
threshold.legal_basis: Ley 14/2013 art. 71 bis + Orden PJC/44/2026 (umbral reducido)

routes.name: Highly qualified professional (profesional altamente cualificado)
routes.summary: Spain's national fast-track for higher-education professionals, or people with equivalent experience, hired by a qualifying employer. One salary threshold, with no reduced version, decided in 20 working days.
preconditions: Your employer qualifies: a large company, an SME in a strategic sector, or a project of general interest — the unit decides

criteria.label: qualification or experience
criteria.note: Ley 14/2013 art. 71.2.b): "una titulación equiparable al menos al nivel 1 del Marco Español de Cualificaciones para la Educación Superior... o conocimientos, capacidades y competencias avaladas por una experiencia profesional de al menos tres años". The law requires 3 years; the nearest declarable option (5-in-last-7) is used — conservative.

criteria.threshold_label: the one salary amount on this route
criteria.note: Threshold PDF value — flagged for human re-verification per project policy. Derivation (UGE PDF, human-read 2026-09-04): "El Instituto Nacional de Estadística (INE) publicó el pasado 28 de mayo de 2026 el dato actualizado del sueldo medio correspondiente a 2024, fijándolo en 29.540,26 €" — the threshold moves whenever the INE publishes a new average (Orden PJC/44/2026, art. 3.2: one month after publication).

threshold.quote: Se establece un umbral único de 41.356,36 €
threshold.legal_basis: Ley 14/2013 art. 71.2.b) + UGE threshold publication (June 2026)

routes.name: Intra-company transfer (traslado intraempresarial)
routes.summary: Your group moves you to its Spanish entity as a manager, specialist or trainee. There is no salary threshold beyond the collective agreement for the job. Up to three years, or one for trainees.
preconditions: The group actually trades — not a shell company
Three months with the group before the move

criteria.note: Ley 14/2013 art. 73.2.c): "La existencia de una relación laboral o profesional, previa y continuada, de 3 meses con una o varias de las empresas del grupo"

criteria.label: qualification or experience
criteria.note: Ley 14/2013 art. 73.2.b): "Titulación superior equiparable al menos al nivel 1 del Marco Español de Cualificaciones para la Educación Superior... o conocimientos, capacidades y competencias avaladas por una experiencia profesional de al menos 3 años".

routes.name: Researcher (investigación, Ley 14/2013 art. 72)
routes.summary: A Spanish university, R&D centre or business school has agreed to host you. Three years, plus a year afterwards to look for work or start a business.
preconditions: A hosting agreement or a contract with the research body

criteria.note: Ley 14/2013 art. 72.2.a): requires "un convenio de acogida o contrato de trabajo" with a research body; UGE: "Extranjeros que desean desarrollar actividades de formación, investigación, desarrollo e innovación en entidades públicas o privadas establecidas en España y que cuentan con una oferta para desarrollar esa actividad."

routes.name: Highly skilled migrant — 30 or older (kennismigrant)
routes.summary: The Dutch highly skilled migrant permit. No degree is needed — the salary is what qualifies you. A lower salary counts if, within the last three years, you graduated from a Dutch university or research institution, or from a foreign institution the Dutch immigration service designates.
preconditions: Your employer is on the Dutch immigration service's (IND) list of recognised sponsors
The salary matches what the job normally pays — the Dutch immigration service judges this
If your profession is regulated (nurses, doctors and similar), you must be in the Dutch BIG register for healthcare professions
The lower salary also applies if you hold, or have held, a Dutch orientation year permit for highly educated people — we do not ask about permits you already hold

criteria.note: IND: "You have an employment contract with an employer or research institution in the Netherlands. This employer is a sponsor recognised by the IND."

criteria.label: the salary this route asks for
criteria.short_reason: at least €5,942/month — or €3,122/month with a degree from the last 3 years, from a Dutch institution or from one the Dutch immigration service designates

criteria.note: IND also applies a market-rate test: "The agreed salary is in line with the market rate."

threshold.quote: Highly skilled migrants 30 years or older € 5,942.00
threshold.legal_basis: Dutch highly skilled migrant scheme — required amounts 2026 (change every 1 January)

paths.label: the lower salary for a recent graduate

criteria.label: where you studied
criteria.short_reason: a degree from the last 3 years, from a Dutch institution or from one the Dutch immigration service designates
criteria.note: IND: "The reduced salary criterion applies in these 3 cases: The residence permit for a highly skilled migrant is applied for during the residence permit for an orientation year for highly educated persons. The highly skilled migrant no longer has a residence permit for an orientation year for highly educated persons, but did have this permit. The residence permit for a highly skilled migrant is applied for within 3 years of the graduation date or date of the doctoral defence ceremony. Or it is applied for within 3 years of the date on which the residence permit for research expired." The third case additionally requires the applicant to meet the requirements for that residence purpose — the orientation year — and that is where the institution restriction lives: a Dutch university or research institution, or a foreign institution the IND designates. Modelled here as the same disjunction the orientation-year route uses. The first two cases (holding, or having held, an orientation-year permit) are NOT modelled: the interview never asks about permits already held. Recorded in data/exclusions.md (2026-09-07) and stated in this route's preconditions.

routes.name: EU Blue Card
routes.summary: A contract of at least six months, plus a higher-education diploma of three years or more — or five years of relevant experience, three years if you work in information technology. Your employer does not have to be a recognised sponsor. A lower salary counts for a degree holder who graduated in the last three years from a Dutch institution, or from a foreign one the Dutch immigration service designates.
preconditions: An employment contract of at least six months
If your profession is regulated, you must be in the Dutch professional register for it (the BIG register, in healthcare)
The lower salary also applies if you hold, or have held, a Dutch orientation year permit for highly educated people — we do not ask about permits you already hold

criteria.note: IND: "Your employment contract is valid for at least 6 months."

criteria.label: diploma or experience
criteria.note: IND: "you have a diploma of a programme in higher education. This programme was at least 3 years." OR "you have a minimum of 5 years of relevant work experience". For IT roles: "Are you an IT manager or IT professional? A minimum of 3 years of relevant work experience is required during the period of 7 years before the application." paths.label: the lower salary for a recent graduate

criteria.label: where you studied
criteria.short_reason: a degree from the last 3 years, from a Dutch institution or from one the Dutch immigration service designates
criteria.note: IND: "The reduced salary criterion applies in these 3 cases: The residence permit for a highly skilled migrant is applied for during the residence permit for an orientation year for highly educated persons. The highly skilled migrant no longer has a residence permit for an orientation year for highly educated persons, but did have this permit. The residence permit for a highly skilled migrant is applied for within 3 years of the graduation date or date of the doctoral defence ceremony. Or it is applied for within 3 years of the date on which the residence permit for research expired." The third case additionally requires the applicant to meet the requirements for that residence purpose — the orientation year — and that is where the institution restriction lives: a Dutch university or research institution, or a foreign institution the IND designates. Modelled here as the same disjunction the orientation-year route uses. The first two cases (holding, or having held, an orientation-year permit) are NOT modelled: the interview never asks about permits already held. Recorded in data/exclusions.md (2026-09-07) and stated in this route's preconditions.

routes.name: Intra-corporate transferee (Directive 2014/66/EU)
routes.summary: Your company moves you to the Netherlands as a manager, specialist or trainee. The salary has to reach the highly skilled migrant level for your age. Up to three years, or one for trainees.
preconditions: At least three months with the company outside the EU
You move in a manager, specialist or trainee role
If your profession is regulated (doctor, architect and similar), you need the Dutch registration for it

criteria.note: IND: "You have already worked for the company outside the EU, EEA or Switzerland for at least 3 months."

criteria.label: the highly skilled migrant salary for your age
criteria.short_reason: at least €5,942/month if you are 30 or older, or €4,357/month if you are under 30
criteria.note: IND: "Your salary is in line with the market. The salary is in line with the market if it meets the salary criterion for highly skilled migrants."

threshold.quote: Highly skilled migrants 30 years or older € 5,942.00
threshold.legal_basis: Dutch highly skilled migrant scheme — required amounts 2026

threshold.quote: Highly skilled migrants younger than 30 years € 4,357.00
threshold.legal_basis: Dutch highly skilled migrant scheme — required amounts 2026

routes.name: Researcher (Directive (EU) 2016/801)
routes.summary: A contract or hosting agreement with a Dutch research institution the immigration service (IND) recognises as a sponsor. Up to five years.
preconditions: The institution is on the Dutch immigration service's (IND) list of recognised sponsors
A degree that would let you start a doctorate, or your employer's statement that your level is equivalent

criteria.note: IND: "You have an employment contract or a host agreement with your employer" — the institute must be a recognised sponsor (public register).
Grants, stipends or own savings also count toward sufficient income; the amount is the gross SV salary per month without holiday allowance.

threshold.quote: These amounts are valid from 1 July 2026 up to and including 31 December 2026. Gross SV salary per month without holiday allowance € 1,635.90
threshold.legal_basis: Researcher (Directive (EU) 2016/801) — required amounts valid 1 July – 31 December 2026

routes.name: Orientation year (zoekjaar)
routes.summary: A one-year permit to look for work. You may take any job without a separate work permit. It is for people who graduated, took a doctorate or did research in the Netherlands — or graduated from a foreign institution the Dutch immigration service (IND) designates — within the last three years. It cannot be extended.
preconditions: You apply within three years of graduating or finishing the research
If you studied abroad: proof of English (IELTS 6.0 or an equivalent test), or a programme taught in English or Dutch

criteria.note: A job-search permit — with an offer, transfer or hosting agreement the work routes apply directly.

criteria.label: where you studied
criteria.note: IND: the qualifying event must fall in "the 3 years before the date of application" — a Dutch institution, or "a designated foreign educational institution". The designation list is published by the IND; the earlier "top 200 in 2 of 3 rankings" reading was not found on the page (human check 2026-09-04) and is no longer asserted.
